Ui.Script:
-- The static category tree (era Game tab, Classic tocs), in list order. Keys are the row -- name suffixes; the visible label doubles as the page title (the era does the same — -- Settings.RegisterCategory names both from one string). OPTIONS_CATEGORY_KEYS = { "Controls", "Interface", "ActionBars", "Combat", "Social", "Keybindings", "Nameplates", "Graphics", "Audio", }
-- The era-window scale (shared, director-owned — the 0219 WORLDMAP_WINDOWED_SCALE -- pattern): the era client's UIParent draws smaller against the screen than our 1.12 -- 768-canvas does on modern displays, and this knob is that mapping — every era-shaped -- window wears it (this window here; GameMenuFrame in its OnShow — in the era both draw -- at the SAME UIParent px-per-unit, the parity the director's eye checked). At 1.0 the -- 724-tall window fills ~85% of the screen's height in our 768-virtual space, where the -- reference at typical resolutions reads nearer two-thirds. ERA_WINDOW_SCALE = 0.78
function OptionsFrame_UpdateScale() -- The era panel is registered `checkFit = 1`: the panel manager also shrinks it to -- fit a small screen (UIPanelUpdateScaleForFit: min over width/height ratios -- against the panel + 20 units of air each way, capped at 1) — transcribed here. local k = ERA_WINDOW_SCALE local wFit = GetScreenWidth() / 940 local hFit = GetScreenHeight() / 744 if wFit < k then k = wFit end if hFit < k then k = hFit end OptionsFrame:SetScale(k) end
-- The era tab width law (MinimalTab.lua l.7): label width + 40. Era measures at OnLoad; -- our measure round-trip answers a frame late, so OnUpdate polls until the width is real -- (the chat-header converge idiom), then latches. Deliberate divergence: the era -- measures with the MEDIUM font it is about to swap away (an accident of its code -- order, ~6 units of extra padding); we measure the small font the label actually -- wears. function OptionsTab_FitWidth(tab) if tab.fitted then return end local w = getglobal(tab:GetName() .. "Text"):GetStringWidth() if w and w > 0 then tab:SetWidth(w + 40) tab.fitted = true end end
-- Each row's OnLoad: remember the key + title, paint the label. The whole row identity -- lives here so adding a category is one XML row + one key in the table above. function OptionsCategoryRow_OnLoad(row, key, label) row.categoryKey = key row.pageTitle = label row:SetText(label) end
-- The selection: exactly one row wears options_list_active + a white label; everyone -- else drops back to bare + gold (the era CategoryList mixin's SetCategoryActive, cut to -- our static list). Also writes the page title and swaps the page BODY: a category with -- rows (OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) shows its body refreshed from the CVars and Defaults goes -- live with it; every other page is still empty, Defaults disabled. function OptionsFrame_SelectCategory(key) OptionsFrame.selectedCategory = key for _, k in ipairs(OPTIONS_CATEGORY_KEYS) do local row = getglobal("OptionsFrameCategoryListRow" .. k) local bg = getglobal("OptionsFrameCategoryListRow" .. k .. "Bg") if k == key then bg:SetAtlas("Options_List_Active", true) row:SetTextFontObject("GameFontHighlight") OptionsFrameContainerTitle:SetText(row.pageTitle) else bg:SetTexture(nil) row:SetTextFontObject("GameFontNormal") end end for k in pairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do local body = getglobal("OptionsFrameContainerBody" .. k) if k == key then body:Show() else body:Hide() end end if OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key] then OptionsPage_Refresh(key) OptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Enable() else OptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Disable() end end
-- ── The setting pages: 1.12 rows in the era Settings grammar ──────────────────────── -- One machinery, every page (Audio 0957, the first). Semantics (rows, CVars, labels, -- dependencies, the click-sound quirk) are the 1.12 client's own panels, quoted -- verbatim (SoundOptionsFrame.lua / OptionsFrame.lua + GlobalStrings.lua); geometry is -- the era settings list (Blizzard_SettingControls.xml/.lua + Blizzard_SettingsList.lua -- @1.15.9 — 26-tall rows on a 9 spacing, label LEFT+37 → CENTER-85, control at -- CENTER-80, child rows +15 indent in the small font). Era rows with no 1.12 CVar + -- benilla knob behind them (Enable Sound=Sound_EnableAllSound, Dialog, output device, -- channels…) do not ship — the 0950 honest-tree rule applied to settings. OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS = { Controls = { "RowStickyTarget", "RowAutoLoot", "RowInvertMouse" }, Audio = { "RowEnableAll", "RowMaster", "RowSound", "RowMusic", "RowAmbience", "RowEnableMusic", "RowEnableAmbience", }, Graphics = { "RowUiScale" }, }
function OptionsRow_OnLoad(row, cvar, label, child) row.cvar = cvar local l = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Label") l:SetText(label) if child then -- era child rows: +15 label indent and the small font -- (SettingControls.lua l.319-322); the control itself does not indent. l:SetFontObject("GameFontNormalSmall") l:ClearAllPoints() l:SetPoint("LEFT", row:GetName(), "LEFT", 52, 0) l:SetPoint("RIGHT", row:GetName(), "CENTER", -85, 0) end end
-- A slider row's own range and readout, when the template's 0..1 / 5% / percent (the -- volume shape) isn't it — called after OptionsRow_OnLoad in the row's OnLoad. The -- refreshing guard: SetMinMaxValues re-clamps the held value and fires OnValueChanged, -- and that clamp is wiring, not a player gesture — without the guard every load would -- SetCVar the template's 0 clamped into the new range. function OptionsSliderRow_Setup(row, min, max, step, fmt) local slider = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "ControlSlider") row.fmt = fmt row.refreshing = 1 slider:SetMinMaxValues(min, max) slider:SetValueStep(step) row.refreshing = nil end
-- The right-hand readout text (era MinimalSlider's RIGHT label seat): rounded percent -- (era FormatPercentage, Audio.lua l.406-411) unless the row asked for the raw number. function OptionsRow_FormatValue(row, value) if row.fmt == "raw" then return string.format("%d", math.floor(value + 0.5)) end return string.format("%d%%", math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5)) end
-- The era row-wide hover wash (HoverBackgroundTemplate, white a=0.1): the row and every -- control on it show the SAME texture, so crossing from label to slider doesn't blink. function OptionsRow_Hover(row, on) local hover = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Hover") if on then hover:Show() else hover:Hide() end end
function OptionsCheckbox_OnClick(box) local row = box:GetParent() local checked = box:GetChecked() -- Click kits: the 1.12 panels disagree with EACH OTHER — the interface panel's -- PlayClickSound maps checked→CheckBoxOn (OptionsFrame.lua l.509), while the sound -- panel's own OnClick maps checked→CheckBoxOff (SoundOptionsFrame.lua, the 0957 -- quirk) — so each page keeps its own panel's mapping (soundQuirk on Audio rows). local kitOn = checked if row.soundQuirk then kitOn = not kitOn end if kitOn then PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") else PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOff") end -- The write: checked = 1 — unless the row is value-INVERTED (Sticky Targeting: -- 1.12 checks it when deselectOnClick is "0", era wraps the same CVar in -- NegateBoolean; both references agree). local on = checked if row.invert then on = not on end if on then SetCVar(row.cvar, 1) else SetCVar(row.cvar, 0) end OptionsPage_UpdateDependencies(OptionsFrame.selectedCategory) end
function OptionsSlider_OnValueChanged(slider, value) local control = slider:GetParent() local row = control:GetParent() if not row.refreshing then -- era obeyStepOnDrag (MinimalSlider.xml l.5-7): user moves snap to the step -- grid — anchored at the range MINIMUM, the reference slider's own anchor -- (farclip's 1.12 grid is 177+n*60, not the multiples of 60). A refresh -- writes the stored value raw (era SetValue does not snap), so an off-grid -- config value still lands where it said. local step = slider:GetValueStep() if step and step > 0 then local minv = slider:GetMinMaxValues() local snapped = minv + math.floor((value - minv) / step + 0.5) * step if math.abs(snapped - value) > 0.00001 then slider:SetValue(snapped) -- re-enters once with the snapped value return end value = snapped -- the clean grid number, not the f32-rounded echo end end getglobal(control:GetName() .. "Value"):SetText(OptionsRow_FormatValue(row, value)) if row.cvar and not row.refreshing then -- Two decimals cover every page's grid (the 5% volumes, uiScale's 0.01, whole -- yards); trailing zeros stripped so a value at the registered default -- compares equal to it as a STRING and stays out of the config file ("0.40" -- would read as moved-off-"0.4"). local str = string.gsub(string.format("%.2f", value), "%.?0+$", "") if row.deferred then -- era CommitFlag.Apply, transcribed (Blizzard_Setting.lua's staged -- SetValue half): the control shows the new value, the ENGINE keeps the -- old one, and the CVar moves only when Apply commits — dragging a -- slider that rescales itself mid-drag is exactly what this flag -- exists to prevent. Dragging back onto the committed value clears the -- pending (era's IsModified: a pending EQUAL to current isn't one). if str == GetCVar(row.cvar) then row.pending = nil else row.pending = str end OptionsApply_Update() else SetCVar(row.cvar, str) end end end
function OptionsStepper_OnClick(btn, dir) local slider = getglobal(btn:GetParent():GetName() .. "Slider") -- era steppers: one step per click, the checkbox-on kit (MinimalSlider.lua l.53-57). PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") slider:SetValue(slider:GetValue() + dir * slider:GetValueStep()) end
function OptionsPage_Refresh(key) local base = "OptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key for _, rkey in ipairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do local row = getglobal(base .. rkey) local box = getglobal(base .. rkey .. "Check") if box then -- SetChecked takes the CVar string exactly like the 1.12 panel: the numeric -- read means "0" unchecks (button-check-and-state-texture.md). A -- value-inverted row checks on "0" instead — UIOptionsFrame.lua's own -- GAMEFIELD_DESELECT arm (`checked = 1` when the CVar reads "0"). if row.invert then local checked if GetCVar(row.cvar) == "0" then checked = 1 end box:SetChecked(checked) else box:SetChecked(GetCVar(row.cvar)) end else local slider = getglobal(base .. rkey .. "ControlSlider") row.refreshing = 1 -- Pending first (era GetValue returns the pendingValue while one is -- staged): coming back to a page with an un-applied edit shows the edit. slider:SetValue(tonumber(row.pending or GetCVar(row.cvar) or "0") or 0) row.refreshing = nil -- SetValue fires only on a CHANGE — write the readout unconditionally, -- from the slider's OWN value: in range that IS the CVar (SetValue stores -- raw), out of range the thumb and the number at least agree on the -- nearest expressible value. getglobal(base .. rkey .. "ControlValue"):SetText( OptionsRow_FormatValue(row, slider:GetValue())) end end OptionsPage_UpdateDependencies(key) OptionsApply_Update() end
-- Per-page dependency rules. Audio's is the 1.12 rule, verbatim: Enable All Sound off -- greys Enable Ambience — and only it, of our rows -- (SoundOptionsFrame_UpdateDependencies disables buttons 2 and 4, Ambience and Error -- Speech; Enable Music stays live, the panel's own quirk). function OptionsPage_UpdateDependencies(key) if key ~= "Audio" then return end local on = GetCVar("MasterSoundEffects") ~= "0" local box = OptionsFrameContainerBodyAudioRowEnableAmbienceCheck local label = OptionsFrameContainerBodyAudioRowEnableAmbienceLabel if on then box:Enable() label:SetFontObject("GameFontNormal") else box:Disable() label:SetFontObject("GameFontDisable") end end
-- Defaults, live on any page with rows: every row's CVar back to its registered -- default (era resets per-setting the same way; the era all-pages confirm dialog is -- not modeled — Defaults resets the VISIBLE page). A pending edit dies with it — the -- default write supersedes what Apply would have committed. function OptionsPage_Defaults(key) local base = "OptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key for _, rkey in ipairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do local row = getglobal(base .. rkey) row.pending = nil SetCVar(row.cvar, GetCVarDefault(row.cvar)) end OptionsPage_Refresh(key) end
-- ── The Apply flow (0961): era CommitFlag.Apply, cut to our rows ──────────────────── -- Pending edits are PANEL-wide like era's modified table: they survive a category -- switch (the row redisplays its pending on return) and commit together; only hiding -- the window discards them (era wipes on hide too — its close-time 3-button confirm -- dialog and the 8-second revert timer are not modeled, SCOPE note).
-- The era Apply gate (HasUnappliedSettings + SetApplyButtonEnabled): the button is -- enabled AND shown together — it EXISTS only while something is pending. function OptionsApply_Update() local pending for key, rows in pairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do local base = "OptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key for _, rkey in ipairs(rows) do if getglobal(base .. rkey).pending then pending = 1 end end end if pending then OptionsFrameApplyButton:Enable() OptionsFrameApplyButton:Show() else OptionsFrameApplyButton:Disable() OptionsFrameApplyButton:Hide() end end
-- Commit (era SettingsPanelMixin:CommitSettings, cut to our rows): every pending -- value everywhere becomes a real SetCVar, and the button goes away. function OptionsPage_Apply() for key, rows in pairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do local base = "OptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key for _, rkey in ipairs(rows) do local row = getglobal(base .. rkey) if row.pending then SetCVar(row.cvar, row.pending) row.pending = nil end end end OptionsApply_Update() end
-- Hide = discard (era's WipeModifiedTable-on-hide; the confirm dialog is cut): the -- next open re-reads the committed CVars, so the sliders land back on the truth. function OptionsPage_DiscardPending() for key, rows in pairs(OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do local base = "OptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key for _, rkey in ipairs(rows) do getglobal(base .. rkey).pending = nil end end OptionsApply_Update() end

Scripts.OnEnter: if OptionsFrame.selectedCategory ~= this.categoryKey then getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Bg"):SetAtlas("Options_List_Hover", true) end
Scripts.OnLeave: if OptionsFrame.selectedCategory ~= this.categoryKey then getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Bg"):SetTexture(nil) end

Scripts.OnLoad: OptionsRow_OnLoad(self, "uiScale", "UI Scale") OptionsSliderRow_Setup(self, 0.64, 1.0, 0.01) -- era registers its uiscale row CommitFlag.Apply -- (Graphics.lua l.684): the one row whose live -- write would rescale the very slider mid-drag — -- it stages and commits through the Apply button. self.deferred = 1

Scripts.OnTextChanged: if this:GetText() == "" then OptionsFrameSearchBoxInstructions:Show() OptionsFrameSearchBoxClearButton:Hide() else OptionsFrameSearchBoxInstructions:Hide() OptionsFrameSearchBoxClearButton:Show() end
